arrive.text: A shared pasture. Anyone may graze their sheep here.

herders.text: Five neighbours, two sheep each. The grass is thick.

add_1.text: One more sheep. A little more for you. The grass belongs to everyone.

follow.text: Your neighbours notice. They add sheep too.

ask.text: Each extra sheep helps its owner, but the cost is shared by all. So why would anyone stop?

bell.text: You ring the bell. The neighbours gather.

agree.text: Together, you agree on limits. Nobody owns the grass, but everyone looks after it.

collapse.text: The grass is gone. For everyone.

sheep.text: This one's yours. She has no idea about any of this.
